Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and major/program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the bachelor of science degree with a major in chemistry.

1)CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit.

Notes:

1)No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.
